item: A Library count stopped for low memory is named as a memory stop, not as passing its time limit
summary: Found by the Opus read of #1439. MemoryShort subclasses StatementTimeout on purpose (every caller already handles a deadline abort), so the count's failure kind, which tested isinstance(exc, StatementTimeout), reported a memory stop as statement-deadline and the tile said 'passed its 300 s limit'. A named reason must be the real one: the kind is now memory-short, the tile says it stopped because the machine was nearly out of memory (one new string in all 12 locales; the non-English lines are drafted, not native-reviewed), and the guard's own numbers are not copied into the figure. Red without: a count that raises MemoryShort must report memory-short and carry none of the guard's numbers.
